query:
MATCH (m:Meeting)
OPTIONAL MATCH (unit:Summary)-[:MADE_AT]->(m)
WHERE EXISTS { MATCH (unit)-[:MODERATED_BY]->(:Company {companyName: 'ZTE'}) }
WITH m, count(DISTINCT unit) AS moderatorSummaryCount
RETURN m.canonicalMeetingNumber AS meetingNumber, m.meetingNumberInt AS meetingOrdinal, moderatorSummaryCount
ORDER BY meetingOrdinal ASC
